subject: Request: short-term SLA uplift & burst policy carveout for CareXpress Q2 Launch
body:
From: Emma Wells <emma.wells@carexpress.health>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Launch week traffic pattern + short-term SLA uplift request

Hi Vanessa,

Quick context: CareXpress is moving to a staged national rollout the weekend of June 4-6 for our tele-triage feature. Traffic will concentrate in a tight 48h window (expected peak TPS ~6x baseline) as we flip a routing flag in prod. Our SRE and product teams are concerned that Redwood's default burst and fairness policies will throttle requests in ways that could materially affect latency for paying customers during the peak.

We'd like to request a short-term carveout: a temporary increase to our burst allowance and a higher per-minute throughput ceiling for that weekend. We understand this is an exception and are prepared to accept a conditional uplift (short window, cost premium, and a rollback). I've attached the launch runbook and a traffic forecast.

Key asks:
- Short window: 2027-06-04 00:00 UTC through 2027-06-06 23:59 UTC
- Burst allowance increase to accommodate 6x observed peak for 48h
- Explicit guarantee that fairness-based throttling will not demote CareXpress requests to lower priority during the window
- Point of contact for emergency throttling/fallback if we see degradation

We need a formal response by EOD Thursday (May 13) to finalize our ops plan.

Thanks,
Emma Wells
Head of Product Ops
CareXpress Health

--- Attachment: CareXpress_Q2-launch-plan.pdf (pdf, 1.2MB)

------------------------------------------------------------

From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
To: marcus_lin@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: emma.wells@carexpress.health
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Launch week traffic pattern + short-term SLA uplift request

Team — forwarding CareXpress' request. They want a short, well-scoped burst uplift and an assurance on fairness policy for a 48h national launch window. Emma needs a formal reply by EOD Thu.

My read: commercial is okay with a time-limited premium; ops will want guardrails (rate cap thresholds, model downgrade fallback). Can we get a proposal that includes: pricing uplift, exact throttling carveout language, metrics we'll monitor, and an emergency runbook item?

Marcus — can you lead the SLA language?
Neha — can you confirm runtime feasibility (KV cache, prefix caching, model fallback)?
Karthik — ping Customer Success for a support contact and DocuSign amendment if needed.

I attached their launch plan.

Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0142

------------------------------------------------------------

On Wed, 12 May 2027 at 08:25, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai> wrote:
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: emma.wells@carexpress.health
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 08:25:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Launch week traffic pattern + short-term SLA uplift request

Vanessa/Team,

Draft proposal below — I'm keeping the carveout tight to control risk. Note this is for review before I put formal language into the amendment doc.

Proposal (summary):
- Window: 2027-06-04 00:00 UTC through 2027-06-06 23:59 UTC (48h active, 72h monitoring)
- Burst uplift: transient allowance up to 6x baseline sustained for up to 8 minutes per 15-min rolling window per shard; aggregate uplift capped at 3x baseline averaged over 1h to protect multi-tenant fairness
- Priority: During the window, CareXpress requests will be assigned a temporary elevated priority group to reduce fairness demotion, subject to the aggregate uplift cap above
- Fallback policy: If infrastructure signals sustained overload (GPU queue depth > 85% for >10m), automated model fallback to a smaller compatible variant will be triggered; Redwood will notify named POCs and open a high-priority incident
- Pricing: temporary surcharge of 50% on per-token billing during the uplift window; minimum uplift fee = $12,500; final pricing and credits negotiable with Sales Approval
- Instrumentation & monitoring: Redwood will provide a shared realtime dashboard (latency p50/p95, error-rate, token/sec, queued requests) and a runbook with automated alerts to CareXpress POCs
- Acceptance & rollback: CareXpress to confirm acceptance by signing a short addendum; Redwood to auto-revert priority and uplifts at window end, with 24h post-window elevated monitoring

Open questions I want input on from Neha/Karthik: exact burst mechanics per shard and whether KV cache priming can reduce needed uplift without raising risk. Also, legal needs the amendment template; Karthik, can you loop in CS for the DocuSign flow?

Marcus Lin
Director, Commercial Solutions | Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.ai

------------------------------------------------------------

From: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
To: marcus_lin@redwood.ai, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: emma.wells@carexpress.health
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 14:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Launch week traffic pattern + short-term SLA uplift request

Quick feasibility notes from runtime:

- KV/prefix caching: We can pre-warm KV cache for the top ~80% of request prefixes in their forecast. That will cut token generation time for those flows by ~20-30% and significantly reduce pressure on the long-tail. CareXpress needs to provide the sample prompt set by May 20 to enable this.
- Batching behavior: For a short window like this, we can increase the batch size threshold for CareXpress-only routing by 2x to improve throughput without materially increasing p95 latency for small requests. We will instrument per-model queue latency and keep p95 under a 350ms target where possible.
- Model fallback: We'll prepare a smaller compatible variant with validated output quality for fallback (will run A/B evals). That fallback will be used only when queue depth triggers the automated rule Marcus listed.
- Operational guardrails: We will require an emergency pause mechanic on the CareXpress side (a single kill-switch flag in their deployment) and a named SRE contact to coordinate.

Requests for CareXpress: provide the final prefix list, expected percent of long-context requests (>2k tokens) and confirm the POC for emergency ops.

-Neha Kapoor
Head of Runtime Reliability | Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.ai

------------------------------------------------------------

From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
To: Emma Wells <emma.wells@carexpress.health>, marus_lin@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 13 May 2027 11:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Launch week traffic pattern + short-term SLA uplift request

Emma — thanks for the clear runbook. Apologies for the slightly delayed turnaround; internal sign-off took a few rounds. Below is the executive summary of what Redwood can commit to for the June launch window. Please review and confirm acceptance by replying to this thread (or sign the attached short addendum) by EOD today so we can finalize ops prep.

Executive summary (commitment):
- Window and scope: Redwood will provision a short-term uplift as drafted: 2027-06-04 00:00 UTC to 2027-06-06 23:59 UTC.
- Performance commitments: Redwood will aim to keep model p95 latency degradation to <20% above baseline for prioritized requests and keep error rates below 1%. If automated fallback triggers, Redwood will notify and minimize quality regressions with the smaller variant.
- Fairness carveout: CareXpress will be placed into a temporary elevated priority queue to reduce fairness demotion; aggregate uplift caps described by Marcus apply to balance cluster health.
- Pricing & billing: Temporary surcharge of 50% on token billing for uplift traffic, with a minimum uplift fee of $12,500. If actual uplift is materially lower than forecast, customer will receive a usage-based credit to the next invoice (formula in addendum).
- Operational steps required from CareXpress: share sample prompt set by 2027-05-20; nominate a production SRE POC; agree to the kill-switch and rollback plan.
- Signoff: Addendum attached for signature (proposed-sla-amendment.docx).

If you accept, we'll schedule a 30-min ops dry-run with our SREs and your POC the week before launch.

Thanks and looking forward —
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0142

Attachment: proposed-sla-amendment.docx (docx, 48KB)

------------------------------------------------------------

From: Emma Wells <emma.wells@carexpress.health>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Cc: operations@carexpress.health
Date: Thu, 13 May 2027 17:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Launch week traffic pattern + short-term SLA uplift request

Vanessa — this looks actionable and addresses our needs. We accept the terms in principle. Two quick clarifications before signature:

1) Can we cap the model fallback to a single, pre-approved model variant so we control the quality regression surface?
2) For the dashboard, can you expose a token/sec timeseries and a p99 latency spike alert to our SRE channel?

We'll reply with the prefix list and SRE POC by 2027-05-20 and circulate the signed addendum once Legal completes a quick review (should be fast). Appreciate the team's responsiveness.

—Emma
Head of Product Ops | CareXpress Health
